title: Replace DateTime.now() with fixed timestamps in bookmark_dao_test.dart for full hermeticity
why: 5 occurrences (lines 37, 56, 83, 110, 129) use wall-clock DateTime.now() for insert timestamps. None is asserted against an exact value, so this isn't flaky today, but it violates TQ-6's hermetic-test requirement and is inconsistent with the sibling bookmark_dao_extra_test.dart, which uses fixed DateTime.utc(...) throughout in the same directory.
recommendation: Replace `DateTime.now()` with a fixed `DateTime.utc(...)` constant, matching bookmark_dao_extra_test.dart's convention.
acceptance_criteria: No DateTime.now() call remains in bookmark_dao_test.dart.
